criteria.criterion: A new crates/athena-core/src/gh/landing.rs holds the Landing row items (work_branch, landed_commit*, squash_text_for, Poll, LandPr, PrReport, land_pr, confirm_existing_merge, refusal_text, publish, Athena::land_pr, Athena::after_merge); git diff shows these as removed from gh/mod.rs and added to landing.rs with identical text apart from import lines and listed pub(super) visibility changes.
criteria.evidence: The mod.rs diff removes exactly these items: work_branch through publish, then the impl Athena block with land_pr and after_merge. `git diff --numstat` of base mod.rs blob against new landing.rs shows only 9 lines of landing.rs that are not in base mod.rs, in order: the 2-line module doc, a blank line, `use super::early::{replace_early, wait_for_checks};` and the 5-line `use super::{...}` block. Every other line of the 569 is base text unchanged, so no visibility was changed (after_merge keeps pub(crate); refusal_text and publish stay private).

criteria.criterion: gh/mod.rs declares `mod landing;` and re-exports every public moved name (land_pr, LandPr, PrReport, Poll, landed_commit*, etc.), so a Grep for `gh::(land_pr|LandPr|PrReport|Poll|landed_commit)` across crates/ and xtask/ shows callers unchanged and none edited.
criteria.evidence: mod.rs adds `mod landing;` and `pub use landing::{LandPr, Poll, PrReport, confirm_existing_merge, land_pr, landed_commit, landed_commit_for, landed_commit_from_records, squash_text_for, work_branch};`. That is every public moved name. The diff changes only CHANGELOG.md, landing.rs, mod.rs and structure-pass.md, so no caller file was edited. Grep shows the callers (run/mod.rs, run_pin_tests.rs, test_support.rs, pr_check.rs, checks.rs, pages.rs, early.rs, cli main.rs, display.rs, wiring.rs, drain.rs, and the cli tests) still in place, and the build compiles.

criteria.criterion: The diff changes no test function names or bodies: only `use` lines in test modules differ, and the set of #[test] fn names in the crate is unchanged (Grep count of `#[test]` before/after equal).
criteria.evidence: `git diff HEAD~1 -G "#\[test\]|fn [a-z_]+\(\)" --stat` returns nothing, so no added or removed line contains #[test] or a zero-argument fn signature. The mod.rs hunks touch only the top-level imports, the mod and pub use declarations, and the moved non-test code. The test modules are not touched at all.

criteria.criterion: gh/landing.rs imports only from host (client), early, records, remote, pages and transport siblings as in structure-pass.md 3.1; no lower-row module imports landing except via the mod.rs re-export, and the early.rs LandPr dependency is noted in CHANGELOG.md.
criteria.evidence: Within gh, landing.rs imports only super::early directly and names from the super re-exports: Checks, GhClient, NewPr, PrDraft, PrHost, parse_remote (host and remote), GitLandingRecords, LandingFacts, LandingRecords, cutover_job_for (records), GitRemote, Remote, PAGES_*, PagesHost, watch_pages (pages), Runner, HostErrorLog (transport). No sibling names `landing::` directly. early.rs imports LandPr and work_branch via `use super::{...}`, and pages.rs imports Poll via `use super::{GhClient, Poll}`. The early.rs dependency is noted in CHANGELOG.md and in structure-pass.md. The entry undercounts the cycles (see findings).

criteria.criterion: CHANGELOG.md has a G7 entry that accurately lists every moved name, every visibility change and every import change kept in mod.rs, and the caller check (which files use each moved name) for each moved name.
criteria.evidence: The G7 entry lists every moved name, including both Debug impls. It correctly says there is no visibility change, which the numstat identity check confirms. It describes the mod.rs import changes as the diff shows them: the early use line is removed, the imports kept for tests become #[cfg(test)], and the list of dropped names matches the removed names. It gives a per-name caller list that matches Grep. Two prose statements about dependencies are inaccurate; they are recorded as minor findings.

criteria.criterion: Run `cargo fmt --all --check`, `cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings` and `cargo test --locked`; all exit 0, including every land_pr_* and early test, with the same number of tests as the recorded base run (1617).
criteria.evidence: Athena's recorded checks on this tree: fmt passed, clippy passed, and cargo test --locked passed with 1617 tests, the same as the recorded base count. I also ran the 75 gh:: tests in athena-core, including every land_pr_* test and the early tests; all passed.

criteria.evidence: I ran a filtered listing that lists 75 gh:: tests in athena-core (gh::tests, gh::tests::records_flow and gh::after_merge_tests), including all land_pr_* tests. The diff touches no #[test] or test fn line (the -G check is empty), so this list is the base list.

findings.summary: The CHANGELOG and structure-pass note say only one dependency between gh siblings runs both ways, but pages and landing also depend on each other.
findings.evidence: pages.rs:3 has `use super::{GhClient, Poll};`, and Poll now lives in landing.rs, while landing.rs imports PAGES_WAIT_DELAY, PAGES_WAIT_LOOKS, PagesHost and watch_pages from pages. The CHANGELOG says "One dependency runs both ways: early.rs ..." and structure-pass.md says "one two-way link remains between early and landing". The caller list does name gh/pages.rs for Poll, but the dependency statements will mislead a later job that tries to remove the cycles. Simpler fix: name both links (early to LandPr and work_branch; pages to Poll).
findings.location: CHANGELOG.md G7 entry; docs/design/structure-pass.md section 3.1 note

findings.summary: The CHANGELOG contradicts itself about what early.rs takes from the landing row.
findings.evidence: It says "early.rs uses LandPr and work_branch through the super re-export" and then "LandPr is the only item early.rs takes from the landing row". work_branch is also a Landing-row item (early.rs:9, 35, 235). The structure-pass note correctly says LandPr and work_branch.

summary: The candidate passes. It is a pure move: it moves the Landing row out of gh/mod.rs into a new gh/landing.rs, and every acceptance criterion is met. Comparing the base mod.rs with the new landing.rs, only 9 lines of landing.rs are new: the module doc and the import lines. Every other line is the base text unchanged, so no visibility changed. mod.rs adds `mod landing;` and re-exports all ten public moved names, and no caller file was edited. The diff touches no #[test] or test function line. Athena's recorded fmt, clippy and full test runs passed with 1617 tests. I ran the 75 gh:: tests, including every land_pr_* and early test, and all passed; their listing matches the base because no test line changed. Four files changed, all on the expected-deliverables list; early.rs and client.rs are listed but untouched. Two minor findings, both in the docs: the CHANGELOG and the structure-pass note say only the early/landing dependency runs both ways, but pages.rs imports Poll from landing.rs while landing.rs imports from pages. The CHANGELOG also says LandPr is the only Landing-row item early.rs uses, though the line before it says early.rs uses LandPr and work_branch.
